# Live2D Cubism Web runtime

This directory contains the unmodified official Cubism Core for Web 5.3 and a
minified IIFE bundle of selected classes from Cubism Web Framework **5-r.5**
(upstream commit `198a376`). The local application loads these files on demand.
WebGL2 is required. The Core supports MOC3 version 6 (Cubism Editor 5.3).
The bundled Core reports native version **6.0.1**. Its SHA-256 is
`8741f739779b5d5210872bd3d7d99f0f1e56e6c87409e7d26d6bb4b80aa1ef47`.
This is the SHA-256 after normalizing CRLF to LF. The current Windows copy has
raw SHA-256 `0ceb97935bb296ac7666824ff13d8dfdc21802b7694152f637502093b88f9412`.
Run `python/Scripts/python.exe live2d-viewer/check_runtime.py` from the repository
root to verify Core and required local runtime files; it never downloads files.

Sources retrieved on 2026-09-14:

- Core: https://cubism.live2d.com/sdk-web/core/06/live2dcubismcore.min.js
- Official version selection: https://www.live2d.com/en/sdk/download/web/
- Framework: https://github.com/Live2D/CubismWebFramework/tree/5-r.5
- Compatibility: https://docs.live2d.com/en/cubism-sdk-manual/compatibility-with-cubism-5-3/

Core is proprietary redistributable code; its full license notice remains embedded
in `live2dcubismcore.min.js`. Framework and shader sources use the Live2D Open
Software License; see `FRAMEWORK-LICENSE.md`. Those are Live2D's licenses, not MIT.

- https://www.live2d.com/eula/live2d-proprietary-software-license-agreement_en.html
- https://www.live2d.com/eula/live2d-open-software-license-agreement_en.html
- https://www.live2d.com/en/sdk/license/

The Framework bundle was generated with the project's existing Rolldown bundler;
no runtime npm dependency or global installation was added. The bundle entry
re-exports the following official source modules/classes, with no source changes:

- `src/live2dcubismframework`: `CubismFramework`
- `src/model/cubismmoc`: `CubismMoc`
- `src/math/cubismmatrix44`: `CubismMatrix44`
- `src/rendering/cubismrenderer_webgl`: `CubismRenderer_WebGL`
- `src/rendering/cubismshader_webgl`: `CubismShaderManager_WebGL`
- `src/effect/cubismeyeblink`: `CubismEyeBlink`
- `src/effect/cubismbreath`: `CubismBreath`, `BreathParameterData`
- `src/physics/cubismphysics`: `CubismPhysics`
- `src/effect/cubismpose`: `CubismPose`
- `src/motion/cubismmotion`: `CubismMotion`
- `src/motion/cubismmotionmanager`: `CubismMotionManager`

In the source workspace `I:/LIVE2DCHAT`, the reproducible entry and bundle are generated by `node scripts/build-cubism-framework.mjs`,
using the unmodified pinned sources at `.cache/cubism-framework-5-r.5/CubismWebFramework-5-r.5/`.

To reproduce it, download the pinned Framework tag, create an entry file with
those re-exports, and call `rolldown.build` with that entry and output options
`{ file: 'framework.js', format: 'iife', name: 'Live2DChatCubismFramework', minify: true }`. Copy the tag's
`Shaders/WebGL/` contents to `shaders/`. Retain the copyright and license files.
Do not replace Core with a floating `latest` URL or an older third-party mirror.
